name: portal-forcer-nether-floor-flattened
notes: Natural nether floor near (0,0): everything but bedrock is cleared in a sealed box over y=1..12 (what a survival player can mine), the floor copied to y=100 for a masked compare. An item goes through an overworld portal at y=3; the Nether exit is generated by PortalForcer.createPortal on the closest frame-capable spot, the bedrock bumps. The final masked compare fails if any bedrock block of the copy changed. The overworld target is a dummy (the harness needs one).

execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:lava

execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:soul_sand

execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:magma_block
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:nether_quartz_ore
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:nether_gold_ore
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:air
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -8 1 -8 8 12 8 minecraft:air replace minecraft:netherrack

execute in minecraft:the_nether run clone -8 0 -8 8 4 8 -8 100 -8

execute in minecraft:the_nether if block 0 0 0 minecraft:bedrock
fill 0 3 0 1 5 0 minecraft:nether_portal[axis=x]

summon minecraft:item 0.5 3.3 0.5 {Item:{id:"minecraft:stone",count:1},NoGravity:1b,PickupDelay:32767}
